descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸菜单，短短薯条旁留着终于够到的蘸酱。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu puts the dipping sauce within reach of a short chip.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的菜单只记这份蒜香黄油做法，不把一种配法当成全部。
descriptions.en: My menu records one garlic-butter preparation, without making it the only way to serve lobster.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己剪的双弧纸签，记着楼梯两边断续露面的问候。
descriptions.en: Two arcs I cut recall the intermittent greetings across the staircases.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在自己的纸卡中间留了个圆缺，像给经过的泡泡让路。
descriptions.en: A round gap in my own paper card leaves space for a passing bubble.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我将几道短折接到一张长折卡上，记着站稳以后送出的问候。
descriptions.en: Several small folds meet in my long paper card for the hello delivered on steady feet.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的纸条两边恢复一样长，纪念从鞋里找出石子后的几步。
descriptions.en: Both sides of my folded strip are even again, recalling the steps after removing the pebble.
